assessments.reasoning: The contemporaneous Apple note specifies a nil result for an object-returning send to a nil receiver. The retired guide describes the same object result within its historical scope.

challenge.method: Inspect the exact nil-return note beside its send premise and compare the directly reacquired retired guide’s object-return and ABI-dependent structure passages.
challenge.results: The older guide limits the aggregate result behavior to the register-return subset and describes a different outcome for other structures. Both representations support the narrow object-only result. Argument evaluation and other return categories remain outside the proposed scope.

limitations: The conclusion concerns the result of a send typed as returning an Objective-C object. Structure ABIs and argument evaluation need separate evidence.
